note: Isracard's tariff of card fees for cards charged to an account by debit authorization (in force from 1 April 2026): a local, international or gold card costs 17.90 shekels a month; its charges are debited from the holder's account each month, written as paid in full. Its credit plans aren't modeled. First International Bank's card tariffs answered with an error page and weren't read.
